candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text is essentially error-free (静かな, 冬のほうが, ことではないか all correct). All sections and the page number transcribed. Boxes rendered as markdown tables, which works but slightly flattens the two-column box layout (e.g., first box merged into a 3-column table row). Underlines in example sentences not represented (minor).

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Many character errors: 「晴かな」 for 静かな, 「Nであるの」 missing ／, 「ナ形「である/な」」 dropping ［で］, 「そであるか」「といいうこと」 typos, 「少しこのほうが」 for 冬のほうが, 「ここではないか」「こうだろう」 for ことではないか/ことだろう, 「～てってこと」 in header. Also invents content: fake furigana 仕(し)事 and a fabricated parenthetical (少し消極的、消極的ともいえるが…) replacing the actual note. Box layout garbled (代わりに split into stray table).

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Character-perfect transcription; all sections, examples, parentheticals, arrow reference, and page number present. Connection-form boxes rendered as code blocks with the vertical divider preserved, closely matching the visual layout. Underlines in examples not marked (minor); extra spaces around Latin letters are a stylistic choice.

rationale: C is the most faithful: no character errors, nothing invented, and its code-block rendering preserves the internal structure (vertical divider, indentation) of the 接続の形 boxes. A is nearly as accurate with zero substantive text errors and full completeness, but its table conversion slightly distorts box layout, so it ranks just below C. B ranks last by a wide margin due to numerous misreadings (晴かな, 少しこのほうが, ここではないか, etc.), dropped particles/brackets in the connection forms, and outright hallucinations (invented furigana and a fabricated parenthetical explanation).
